silver.view: Expect continued choppiness after the weekly washout. Stagger entries in tranches instead of going all in, keep position sizes small, and prefer a longer holding period.

trading_tips: Risk only 1 to 2 percent of your trading capital on any single trade; one bad earnings-season gap should never threaten your account.
Place the stop-loss at order entry, not after the price moves against you; with VIX at 14 and event days ahead (FOMC 27-28 Oct), overnight gaps are real.

F&O is more expensive since 1 April 2026: STT is 0.05% on futures, 0.15% on options premium and 0.15% on exercised options. Factor that into breakeven before sizing up; expiry-day leverage is where most retail accounts get hurt.
Do not trade on tips, social media buzz or forwarded messages. Verify every claim against the exchange filing or a SEBI-registered research analyst's note.
Penny stocks are thin: use limit orders, keep position sizes small, and check circuit filters and delivery percentage before entering; a 17% intraday spike can reverse just as fast.
Earnings gaps cut both ways: banks reported on a Saturday and IT results have moved stocks 4 to 8% in a session. Avoid naked overnight positions into known results dates (Infosys reports 23 Oct).
Keep an emergency fund completely separate from trading capital, and never trade with borrowed money; with the RBI repo at 5.50% and US yields above 5%, leverage costs more than most traders assume.
Journal every trade: entry, exit, reason, and what you would do differently. Review it weekly; the journal, not the P&L, is what compounds.
